title: Fraud scoring on a mainframe
request: Add real-time fraud scoring to our card payments flow. Problem: our core payments engine is a 15-year-old COBOL system running on a mainframe, processing transactions in nightly batch settlement windows only. There is no public API, no webhook mechanism, and no real-time hooks anywhere in the system. The vendor no longer offers custom development on this platform. Compliance requires every fraud decision to be logged and explainable. We need a way to score transactions for fraud risk before they settle, without a multi-year mainframe replacement project.

title: SSO on a legacy HR suite
request: Add single sign-on (SSO) login to our internal HR portal. Problem: the HR portal runs on a vendor HR suite purchased over a decade ago. The vendor's authentication module only supports basic username/password and does not support SAML or OAuth, and the vendor has confirmed no roadmap to add modern SSO. IT security has mandated all internal tools support SSO within two quarters.

title: Self-service refunds on legacy Oracle Financials
request: Add a customer-facing self-service refund request flow. Problem: refunds currently go through our on-prem Oracle Financials instance and are processed manually — a finance team member exports a CSV of approved refunds each morning and uploads it into Oracle's batch refund import screen. There is no refund API, and finance cannot take on more manual steps. Customers currently wait 5-7 business days for refund confirmation because of this batch process.
